decisions.reason: Correctly connects the session and worker to the live global dsh installation, explains the host/GUI dying during replacement, and preserves the tool result as unknown rather than claiming install success or blaming networking.
Correctly identifies present rc.1 content alongside missing dsh and dsh.cmd and stale dsh.ps1, and rejects manual directory or shim repair as unsafe and incomplete.
Accurately reports the external pinned npm reinstall, regenerated shims, rc.1 version verification, and matching source-tag alignment, while distinguishing recorded repair from proposed checks.

Requires stopping the host before an exact-version external install, then verification, restart, browser refresh, and smoke testing; it correctly distinguishes established upgrade rules from the self-host execution boundary.

Proposes a runtime-path guard, checks exact version, shims, startup and plugin loading, delays backup cleanup until verification, and correctly notes that alpha.5-to-rc.1 requires no plugin API migration.

caps.reason: The report explicitly rejects executing the global install from the live target session and requires an external process after the host stops.
